sources.title: Sources and licences
sources.intro: Facts shown for a trip come from these sources. Each block names its source and the date it was checked.
sources.note: Weather data is free for non-commercial use.

ourairports.label: Airport positions: OurAirports
ourairports.provides: Airport names and positions from a bundled dataset. Used for flight time estimates (distance to the nearest airport) and for the airport search; no flight is looked up from it.

open_meteo.label: Open-Meteo (ERA5 2016–2025)
open_meteo.license: CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information.

osm.label: © OpenStreetMap contributors
osm.provides: Candidate places such as sights and golf courses. Queried via Geoapify (Powered by Geoapify), with the Overpass API as fallback.
osm.license: ODbL 1.0. The copyright page must be linked.

wikivoyage.label: Wikivoyage
wikivoyage.license: CC BY-SA 4.0. A shortened excerpt is shown with a link to the article.

wikipedia.label: Wikipedia
wikipedia.provides: Destination description when the Wikivoyage intro is very short.
wikipedia.license: CC BY-SA 4.0. A shortened excerpt is shown with a link to the article.

wikimedia.label: Wikimedia Commons and Wikidata
wikimedia.provides: Picture of the destination (page banner or main image of the place). For city tours: how well known a place is (number of Wikipedia and other Wikimedia articles about it), to order the suggestions.
wikimedia.license: Per picture: CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA. Author and licence are shown under the picture.

rest_countries.label: Country data: mledoze/countries (ODbL)
rest_countries.provides: Country facts such as currency, language and driving side from a bundled dataset (rebuilt about yearly).
rest_countries.license: ODbL 1.0, data as of the build date.

aerodatabox.label: Flight schedules: AeroDataBox
aerodatabox.license: RapidAPI Basic plan (non-commercial use, attribution required).

suncalc.label: computed (suncalc)
suncalc.provides: Sunrise, sunset and twilight, calculated from coordinates and date.

openrouteservice.label: Drive times: openrouteservice.org
openrouteservice.provides: Drive time and road distance by car from the destination centre to each suggested place, and the ways, times and distances of city tours.
openrouteservice.license: © openrouteservice.org by HeiGIT, map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0).

mapTiles.label: Map tiles: OpenFreeMap
mapTiles.provides: The map of city tours. Your browser loads the map tiles directly from OpenFreeMap (tiles.openfreemap.org); the service sees your IP address and the map area. No cookies are set. Without the map, the tour stays usable as a list.

userAccounts.title: User accounts
userAccounts.intro: Disable blocks a person without deleting anything; you can enable them again later. Delete removes the account and all its data permanently. You cannot change yourself, other admins or the demo account.
userAccounts.disableBody: The person is signed out within moments and cannot sign in. Their data and share links stay but are not reachable until you enable them again.
userAccounts.deleteBody: The account and all their data (trips, groups, purposes, plans, share links) are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone. They need a new invitation to come back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Switches and limits you can change here without a restart. Order: admin value, then environment variable, then default. A change takes effect at once on this instance; other instances catch up within 30 seconds. Secrets (API keys) are never stored here.
settings.lockedHint: The variable is set to false (emergency off). It can only be changed in the Vercel environment variables.

start.title: Getting started
start.lead: In four short steps you set up what the travel planner may know about you. Everything is optional: skip any step and come back whenever you like.
start.finishHint: You can find this page again under Settings and on the Trips page.
start.failed: Could not save that. Please try again.
start.skippedNote: Skipped. You can catch up on this any time.

about.title: About you
about.nameWhy: Your name is only used to greet you in the app.
about.languageWhy: The language of the app and of your generated plans.
about.homeWhy: Your home place is the start of a search by driving time and sets the time difference of your plans (default: Germany). The place name appears on shared plan links and PDFs.
about.airportsWhy: With your home airports we later look only for direct flights that really start near you.
about.birthdateWhy: With your birthdate we work out “my age” and know your age on the travel date.
about.done: Saved. You can change this any time in Settings.

group.title: Who is travelling?
group.why: A travel group describes who the plan is for. One sentence is enough, details are optional.
group.name: Group name
group.descriptionHint: In your own words. The app picks out the number and ages.
group.doneExisting: You already have a travel group.

purpose.title: Why are you travelling?
purpose.why: A trip purpose says what the trip is about: relaxing, sport, culture. Free text or guided fields, reusable for every trip.
purpose.example1: “Golf trip: flat courses, good food in the evening”
purpose.example2: “City trip with a child: short distances, playgrounds”
purpose.name: Purpose name
purpose.doneExisting: You already have a trip purpose.

trip.title: Your first trip
trip.why: A trip needs only a destination and a length. Group, purpose and everything else are optional and can be added later.
trip.done: You have already created a trip.
trip.discoverWhy: No destination yet? “Find destinations” suggests places for a trip purpose, within an estimated flight time from your home airports or a driving time from your home place. Flights are checked once you create the trip.

link.settingsHint: A short introduction: name, language, home airports and home place, travel groups, trip purposes and your first trip.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Found a problem or have an idea? Tell us. You do not need a GitHub account.
feedback.notice: Your text will be published in our public GitHub project, without your name. Email addresses and phone numbers are removed automatically. Please leave out names, dates and trip details. Screenshots stay private; only the operator can see them. A report that has been published stays on GitHub even if you delete your account later. It carries no name, only the reference FB-….
feedback.closed: Feedback is paused at the moment. Please try again later.

routeHelp.no_highways: No motorways. Depends on the OpenStreetMap data of the area.
